item.title: Week 11: Buccaneers at Lions
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: DET -6.5 · O/U 46.5 | Model DET 74% vs. market 74% | Tampa Bay has to hunt explosive plays against a Detroit defense that allows a 9.4% rate, which ranks 25th, so the Bucs cannot stall on early downs. Baker Mayfield must survive a Detroit pass rush that generates pressure on 24% of dropbacks, and he averages -1.26 EPA per dropback when pressured. Our model and the market both put Detroit at 74%, and the starting quarterback edge drives most of that number.
